verifications.claim: Brand New Day is scheduled for a theatrical release on July 31, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day will hit theaters on July 31, 2026'; R2: 'scheduled to hit theaters on July 31, 2026'; R3: 'will hit theaters on July 31, 2026'; R4: 'hits cinemas on 31 July'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the exact theatrical release date.

verifications.claim: Brand New Day is a Marvel Cinematic Universe film.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Marvel Studios released the first trailer', 'Marvel Cinematic Universe role'; R2: 'Holland’s seventh appearance in the Marvel Cinematic Universe'; R3: 'MCU movies'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly place it in the MCU context with Marvel Studios involvement and character continuations.

verifications.claim: Brand New Day follows Peter Parker's life after the events of No Way Home.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Coming off the shocking ending of No Way Home'; R2: 'set four years after the events of No Way Home'; R3: 'takes place four years after the events of No Way Home'; R4: 'picks up four years after the events of No Way Home'
verifications.reasoning: All sources directly confirm the timeline post-No Way Home.

verifications.claim: Brand New Day was unveiled in March 2026.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: Sources mention trailer release in March 2026 and earlier title announcement at CinemaCon 2025, but no mention of the film itself being unveiled in March 2026.

verifications.claim: Brand New Day has wrapped filming.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Production... lasted from August to December 2025'; R3: 'Filming wrapped in December 2025'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state production/filming concluded in December 2025.

verifications.claim: Brand New Day is part of Phase 6 of the MCU.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'as part of Phase 6 of the MCU'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statement in R2 confirms Phase 6 placement.

verifications.claim: Brand New Day was previously slated for July 24, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'one week later than its initial release date of July 24'
verifications.reasoning: R3 explicitly states the prior date was July 24.

verifications.claim: Brand New Day was moved to avoid competing directly with other major releases, according to People.com.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3 (people.com): 'The new date will distance the film further from the premiere of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey... on July 17'
verifications.reasoning: R3 from People.com directly explains the date shift to avoid overlap with another major release starring the leads.
